paragraphs.text: A shared kanban board for people and AI agents in DeepSeek Harness.
简体中文 · English
Get started · User guide · Agent tools
Turn plans from your conversations into tasks you can move forward. You and your agent share one boa
rd for planning, context, and progress, all inside DeepSeek Harness.
Current plugin UI · Isolated demo data · A separate board for every workspace
## From a conversation to the next step
### Describe the goal. Let your agent create the tasks.
Ask your agent to break down a requirement, write implementation steps and acceptance criteria, and
assign labels and priorities. With 19 built-in tools, the plan goes straight onto the board.
> Break phone sign-in into testable tasks. Check existing cards first to avoid duplicates. Write imp
lementation steps and acceptance criteria for each card, and mark launch blockers as P0.
### See the progress. Take over at any time.
Drag cards between stages, then use search and filters to find the next task. Markdown descriptions,
comments, and activity history keep the work's context in one place.
| What matters | How to find it |

| Important work | P0 / P1 / P2 priorities and custom labels |
| Upcoming deadlines | Due dates, due

-today and overdue filters |
| Existing decisions | Search card IDs, titles, full descriptions, and

overdue filters |
| Existing decisions | Search card IDs, titles, full descriptions, and comments |
### Bring the context back into conversation.
Paste or drop screenshots into a task, then choose **Create new conversation** to bring its text and
saved images into a new conversation in the selected workspace. Everything starts as an editable dr
aft for you to review and send.
Image and saving rules → · More prompt examples →
## Get started
**Desktop** — Open **Plugins**, add `@alpacachen/dsh-kanban`, and enable it.
**Web** — Run the command below, then restart `dsh web` to load the plugin.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Open **Board** in the upper-left sidebar, then click the workspace name at the top to switch boards.
Start with four default stages:
**Todo → In Progress → Review → Done**
Declared compatibility: DSH **0.2.0-rc.2 / 0.2.1-rc.3 / 0.2.2-rc.1**, on Web and desktop. Version 1.
10 uses newer image-preview and conversation-attachment APIs; upgrade DSH first if you use 0.1.5.
Check the Web plugin configuration

Look for a `dsh-kanban` layer. Its presence confirms the configuration, not that the running service
has loaded it; restart the Web service after installation.
